import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("ai_visibility.csv", parse_dates=["date"])

# filter date range (inclusive)

end = "2026-09-27"

# assume top-10 columns are named top1, top2, ..., top10; adjust names if different

# if the CSV stores them in a single column (e.g., comma-separated), split first

# gather all URLs from top-10 columns into one series

for c in top_cols:
    if c in df.columns:
        urls = urls.append(df[c].dropna(), ignore_index=True)

# normalize / strip whitespace
